write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for pharmacy technician work! It connects inpatient sterile compounding and dispensing cabinet work to the amount you handle, while showing your earlier retail experience.

The cabinet restocking line is a great model: it names the six nursing units and shows how stockout reports changed. The main friction is that the job dates and duties sit in separate sections, so a recruiter has to match them up.

Put each set of duties directly under its job, and keep the certifications easy to find. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a call back, though competition for a particular role still matters.
